text:
jade.partnerships: Quick sync — proposing a pilot for curated mentor pairs + scheduled HW access windows from our marketplace partners. Goal: shorten SI ramp, reduce support tickets during lab weeks. TL;DR: matching criteria, weekly access slots, mentor responsibilities. Thoughts?

lia.si_ops: love it. can we keep mentor pairings to 1:3 max? too many mentees dilutes impact. also need an access SLA for HW (start/end windows). :+1:

tom.engineering: 1:3 sounds sane. question: how do we provision marketplace HW for the labs? do we use partner vouchers or a pooled account? partner contracts vary.

jade.partnerships: good q. plan is hybrid: voucher-first (preferred), fall back to pooled infra for no-voucher regions. i've sketched a matrix for partner readiness. will share.

ben.training: timeline callout — certification checkpoint should be after week 4 lab block (so mentors can nominate pass/fail demos). also need rubrics. I'll draft rubrics next week.

lia.si_ops: proposal for schedule (ETA):
```yaml
week0: onboarding + env setup (self-paced)
week1: mentor shadow + live q&a
week2: hands-on lab A (HW slot 1)
week3: hands-on lab B (HW slot 2)
week4: capstone demo + cert checkpoint
```
keep HW slots to 90min windows to limit queueing.

tom.engineering: re: provisioning — can we automate voucher redemption via a small script? something like `curl -X POST https://marketplace.example/redeem -d "code=$VOUCHER"` and return creds to the trainee. makes ops lighter.

jade.partnerships: yes, automation is ideal. Tom, can you prototype a redeem endpoint wrapper and a short runbook for mentors? lia, can we reserve 6 slots per region for the pilot?

tom.engineering: I'll put a prototype in a gist by EOD tomorrow. will include sample responses and error handling (rate limit backoff).

lia.si_ops: Reserving 6/region OK for pilot Q1. I'll follow up with partner PMs to confirm quotas.

ben.training: rubric highlights: architecture rationale, inference perf baseline on Redwood Dedicated or partner HW, and a short troubleshooting log. Mentors to sign off via a Google form.

jade.partnerships: sounds great. open items: 1) mentor onboarding checklist (assign mentor pairs) 2) voucher automation & security review 3) partner quota confirmation 4) cert rubric doc. I'll spin up a short Notion page and invite you all.

deploy-bot: reminder: "SI Onboard Pilot - approvals" workflow will auto-run if Notion page is created. Approval step: security review.

lia.si_ops: fyi — any partner that requires a PO for vouchers will add lead time. i'll flag partners with procurement friction on the Notion page.

tom.engineering: small ask — include a minimal SDK snippet for redeem in the mentor runbook. saves copy/paste errors.

jade.partnerships: will do. thanks everyone — i'll create the Notion page and a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff. expected pilot cohort: 9 SIs (3 mentors x 3 mentees).

ben.training: +1, happy to get rubric draft into the doc before the kickoff.

lia.si_ops: thanks — will loop partner ops and add a checklist for partner onboarding tasks. :rocket:

jade.partnerships: closing note — objective for pilot: reduce first-week infra support tickets by 60% and get 75% of cohort to pass capstone by week 4. we'll track via support tag `si-pilot` and cert form responses.

tom.engineering: noted — will add telemetry hooks for infra errors and voucher failures.

jade.partnerships: perfect. last_message_ts: 1712350920 — thanks all.
